title: Modular type scale with size and line-height floors
asA: user reading the interface for hours
iWant: text sized and spaced for sustained reading
soThat: nothing important is squint-small or cramped

acceptanceCriteria.description: All font sizes resolve to the typography tokens, which realise a modular scale with ratio 1.125 or 1.25; off-scale literal sizes do not appear in component styles.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every size maps to a scale token

acceptanceCriteria.description: Body text renders at 14px minimum below 768 and 16px minimum at 768 and above.
acceptanceCriteria.given: body text at each baseline breakpoint

acceptanceCriteria.description: Type scales fluidly between breakpoints rather than jumping only at breakpoint edges.
acceptanceCriteria.when: body and heading sizes are sampled
acceptanceCriteria.then: sizes interpolate smoothly within the declared bounds

acceptanceCriteria.description: Line height is 1.5 for body text and 1.2 for headings across the application.
Text containers tolerate 200% browser zoom without loss of content or functionality.
acceptanceCriteria.then: all content remains readable and operable
